acceptance_boundary: Only the relevant utility, land, drainage, highway, operations and design authorities can accept their evidence, followed by the engineer of record, operator and information manager accepting the coordinated route-fit record.
controlled_storage_policy: Store titles, personal data, utility-sensitive records, permits and native studies in the controlled project environment. Git carries requirements, empty receipts, immutable hashes and non-sensitive acceptance summaries.
technical_boundary: The automated gate proves that every current line and station is covered by hash-locked, internally consistent route-fit evidence and that no unresolved critical/high issue is hidden. It does not determine land rights, utility position, flood risk, accessibility, traffic safety, lifting feasibility or possession sufficiency.
